name: Palau
summary: Palau has no general personal income tax: after the January 2023 tax reform (10% Palau Goods and Services Tax, Business Profits Tax, reformed Wages Tax) the Ministry of Finance states that the regime 'does not include a general personal income tax'. Investment income and capital gains of individuals are therefore untaxed as far as found. No inheritance, gift or wealth tax was found.

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: No general personal income tax; wages tax on employment income; business taxes on businesses.
regimes.eligibility: No tax residence test is relevant for investment income (no personal income tax).

capital_gains.summary: No tax on individuals' capital gains (no general personal income tax).

sources.title: Economic and Fiscal Update FY2024 (tax reform section)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Republic of Palau

capital_gains.rate_basis: Ministry of Finance FY2024 Economic and Fiscal Update: 'the current reformed regime does not include a general personal income tax, which would form a second phase of the reforms'.
capital_gains.professional_trader: A trading business would fall under Business Profits Tax / gross receipts tax (rates not verified).
capital_gains.important_exceptions: A second phase of tax reform could introduce a personal income tax (announced as possible, nothing enacted found).
open_questions: Primary legislation (RPPL 11-11 and the Palau National Code Title 40) not read.

dividends.summary: No tax on individuals' dividends (no general personal income tax).

sources.title: Economic and Fiscal Update FY2024 (tax reform section)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Republic of Palau

dividends.rate_basis: No general personal income tax (FY2024 Economic and Fiscal Update). Foreign withholding (e.g. US 30%) is a final cost.
dividends.treaty_network: No comprehensive treaties found (not verified). Palau uses the US dollar under its Compact of Free Association.

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax and no recurring levy on financial assets.

sources.title: Economic and Fiscal Update FY2024 (tax reform section)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Republic of Palau

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax found among Palau's taxes (PGST, excises, business profits tax, gross receipts tax, wages tax, room tax).

sources.title: Economic and Fiscal Update FY2024 (tax reform section)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Republic of Palau

open_questions: Foreigners cannot own land in Palau (general knowledge, not verified).

residency.tax_residency_test: No personal income tax on investment income, so no relevant tax residence test. Palau's 'digital residency' card is an ID product, not tax or immigration residence.

sources.title: Ministry of Finance (Bureau of Revenue and Taxation)
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Palau

corporate.summary: Business Profits Tax for larger businesses introduced in January 2023, medium businesses stay on the Business Gross Receipts Tax and small ones pay an annual fee (FY2024 Update); rates not verified.

sources.title: Economic and Fiscal Update FY2024 (tax reform section)

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax.
open_questions: Palau legislation not read; confidence rests on the Ministry of Finance's description.
